# Agent Feature Brief

Use only when a feature is large/ambiguous enough that a durable product brief
will reduce rework. For a normal bounded PR, the existing
`docs/CODEX_WORK_PACKAGE_TEMPLATE.md` is sufficient.

## Problem / opportunity

What operator/user problem is being solved?

## End state

What observable behavior should exist when complete?

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ]
- [ ]
- [ ]

## Constraints

Product, UX, architecture, hardware, compatibility, or security constraints.

## Non-goals

What is explicitly outside this work?

## Open product decisions

Only decisions that cannot be resolved from current repository/product
authority.

## Evidence / research links

Current external evidence only when needed.

## Handoff

Translate the approved brief into
`docs/CODEX_WORK_PACKAGE_TEMPLATE.md` before implementation if the work is
Standard/Architectural or requires multiple milestones.
